## Summary
This package implements remote bandwidth estimation for the SFU. It combines REMB estimates, expected bandwidth usage, repeated-NACK ratios, channel trend observation, probe control, RTT smoothing, and congestion-state callbacks.

## Responsibilities
- Track remote estimate trends and repeated-NACK ratios for congestion detection.
- Maintain remote BWE congestion state and committed channel capacity.
- Control probe cluster lifecycle, hangover, finalization, and probe signals.
- Process REMB feedback and notify listeners when congestion state changes.
- Provide default configuration for channel observers, NACK tracking, probe control, and remote BWE behavior.
